name: Issue 1136: Turbulence leaves a damaging Turbulent Spiral on every tick
contract: Turbulence 705575 (Riftblade talent) reads 'Send out a gust of wind ... strikes nearby enemies in a
$706526a1 (6) yd radius for $706526s1% (200%) Weapon Damage as Nature damage every $t1 (0.5) sec for $d
(3 sec). While active, you leave behind a Turbulent Spiral every $t1 sec for $707153d (6 sec).' The spiral,
rendered from 707153, reads 'Enemies in the area take an additional ${$707153m1+$707153ppl1+$AP*0.135}
Nature Damage every $707153t1 sec.' Effect 0 is aura 23 triggering the gust 706526 every 500 ms; nothing in
the record casts 707153 (a 3 yd persistent area aura, periodic damage every 1000 ms, SpellDuration 32 = 6 sec),
and no spell_bonus_data row gave its tick the 0.135 attack power. Expected: 5-6 gust ticks, each also leaving
one spiral at the caster; an enemy 2 yd away takes spiral damage; the last spiral outlasts Turbulence and all
expire within 6 sec after. A tick gains 0.135 per point of attack power times the caster's own damage done
(about 1.11 on this fixture), a 0.13-0.16 window that excludes the 0.17 of 706526's stale helper text x1.11.
After the first spiral, move its caster five yards sideways. The victim stays in the first three-yard
spiral and within the six-yard gust radius, while later spirals are outside the victim. This exercises
the authored leave-behind condition without overlapping same-caster periodic area aura applications.

steps.label: A Turbulent Spiral tick gains 0.135 per attack power (times the caster's damage done)
SETUP: no Turbulent Spiral before Turbulence
Turbulence leaves a Turbulent Spiral behind
Leave the first spiral behind before later spirals form
CONTROL: victim stays inside gust radius and outside later spiral radius
An enemy in the spiral takes its Nature damage
Turbulence ticks every 0.5 sec for 3 sec
The gust strikes the nearby enemy on every tick
Each tick leaves exactly one Turbulent Spiral
The spirals expire 6 sec after they are left
